title: feat(lint): warn when a package namespace is too long to have a paired customization namespace
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Sb8nicvrXvYFwDvb6LLSn4)_

Fixes #28473

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增一条只告警、不拒收的作者期规则 `namespace-no-customization-pair`：包的 `manifest.namespace` 超过 13 个字符时，`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 提示"这个包没有配对的 `_custom` 定制命名空间"，并给出 `os explain` 说明。
- 为什么改：按 #28404 的裁决（「同意」），命名空间超长的基础包拿不到配对定制包，确保定制包的入口会直接拒绝，安装方永远无法定制它；以前作者要等客户第一次定制被拒才知道，那时改命名空间等于改所有对象名和表名。
- 风险与回滚：只多一条 warning，不拒收任何东西，也不进运行时发布门；仓库内已发布的包和示例最长命名空间是 13 字符，没有一个会触发。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-customization-namespace.ts`（判定只读 spec 的 `customizationNamespace`，不另写数字）、`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 末尾的注册项、`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` 的新条目。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-customization-namespace.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全过（13 字符静默，14 字符告警，`.custom` 配对包本身静默）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New advisory rule** `validateCustomizationNamespace` (`packages/lint/src/validate-customization-namespace.ts`), rule id `namespace-no-customization-pair`, severity `warning`. For each package one install delivers (`packages[].manifest` when the stack carries `packages[]`, the top-level `manifest` otherwise; an artifact's own wrapper manifest is not judged), it asks `customizationNamespace(manifest.namespace)` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` and reports exactly its `base_namespace_too_long` refusal, at `manifest.namespace` (or `packages[N].manifest.namespace`).
- **One reader.** The verdict is the helper the ensure door creates the pair with. The sentence is built from `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` and `CUSTOMIZATION_NAMESPACE_SUFFIX`; the rule spells neither 13 nor `_custom` itself. The grammar maximum it prints is `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH + CUSTOMIZATION_NAMESPACE_SUFFIX.length`, the identity `customization-package.ts` defines the limit by.
- **Not judged:** a package that is itself a pair (`customizationPackageId` answers `base_is_customization_package`: a pair is never paired again); the helper's `base_namespace_missing` and `base_namespace_invalid` refusals (the second is `os validate`'s grammar refusal).
- **Registry entry** in `AUTHORING_RULES`: `tier: 'advisory'`, `input: 'normalized'`, all three commands, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY` with a `surfaceReason` (a package manifest is not a metadata item, so the runtime publish gate has nothing to judge; the ensure door already refuses at 409).
- **`os explain namespace-no-customization-pair`**: a new entry in `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (the table `os explain` reads; `packages/cli` is unchanged).
- **Barrel**: `validateCustomizationNamespace`, `NAMESPACE_NO_CUSTOMIZATION_PAIR` and the `CustomizationNamespaceFinding` type from `@objectstack/lint`'s root entry (the rule-id barrel test requires the id there).
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/28473-namespace-no-customization-pair.md`, `@objectstack/lint` patch.
- **Docs, forced**: four CLI transcripts print the author-time rule count, which the registry derives (`authoringRulesFor`), 58 → 59: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` (`check:docs-transcript-drift` reds without it).

## Why

ADR-0146 D3 names a base package's paired customization package's namespace `BASE_NS_custom`. The manifest namespace grammar admits 20 characters and the suffix takes 7, so a base namespace over 13 characters has no pair namespace. The ruling on #28404 (comment 6549129352, 「同意」) answers that with a named refusal and no truncation or hashing, and the ensure door refuses such a base with `409`. Its installers can never customize it, and its author would learn that only when a customer first tried. This is follow-up (a) of that ruling.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-customization-namespace.test.ts` (new, 13 cases): the fixtures sit on the helper's own boundary; 13 characters silent; 14 characters warns at `manifest.namespace` with severity `warning`; the message names `warehouse_mgmt_custom`; a `.custom` pair with a 20-character namespace is silent while the same namespace on a base warns; missing, empty and grammar-invalid namespaces are silent; no `manifest.id` still judged; artifact `packages[]` judged per body and the wrapper never; the CLI per-package view of each body yields the union run's findings byte for byte (so the CLI's per-package de-duplication adds no second copy); registry entry shape; all three commands report it; barrel and explain entry present.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.test.ts`: one added case holds the explanation's written numbers and suffix (the module imports nothing) to the spec constants.
- Forced test edits: none. Forced docs edits: the four transcript counts above.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch expected the `os explain` catalogue in `packages/cli`. It lives in `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (published as `@objectstack/lint/rule-explanations`); the CLI's `os explain` and `rule:` pointer read it, so `packages/cli` needs no edit. `packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` iterates every entry through the command and covers the new one.
- Public surface, measured: `@objectstack/lint`'s root entry gains one function, one rule-id constant and one type, and `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` gains one key (its type is unchanged). No accept set changes: the rule never emits `error`. Other new lint rule ids landed under `Clause-②: no` (for example `.changeset/26719-list-view-chart-foreign-dataset.md`).
- Boundary, not filed: the ensure door also refuses a base that declares no namespace (`base_namespace_missing`, 409). This rule does not judge that case; the ruling names the long one.

## Verification

Final head `365377b2` (main merged at `5493b884`). The lint tree is byte-identical between the merge commit `0780c708` and the final head (the last commit touches `content/docs` only), so the lint and CLI readings taken on `0780c708` hold for it.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` on `0780c708`: Test Files 188 passed (188), Tests 7777 passed (7777). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` on `0780c708`: exit 0 (spec moved on main's side; nothing to regenerate here).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` on `0780c708`: 364/365 files, 5174/5175 tests. The one red, `src/utils/override-declarations.test.ts`, arrived with the merge (main's flow-override change) and read a stale `metadata-protocol` dist; after rebuilding the packages the merge moved (`metadata-protocol`, `objectql`, `service-automation`) it passed 7/7. Before the merge, on `15f94cb9`: 363/365, the two reds being `published-subpath-*.pin.test.ts` needing the CLI's own dist; after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, 29/29.
- CLI explain and per-package seams: `test/explain-rule-id.test.ts`, `test/union-fold-command-parity.test.ts`, `test/lint-per-package-authoring-seam.test.ts`, `test/validate-per-package-authoring-seam.test.ts`, `test/per-package-dedup-positional-echo.test.ts`: 5 files, 36 tests passed.
- eslint over the six changed `packages/lint/src` files: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>End to end, through the public door</summary>

A throwaway `defineStack` config with `manifest.namespace: 'warehouse_mgmt'` (14 characters), run with the built CLI:

- `os validate`: exit 0, and prints the warning `package "com.acme.warehouse": namespace "warehouse_mgmt" is 14 characters, so this package has no paired customization namespace: "warehouse_mgmt_custom" would be 21, past the 20 a namespace may have, and installers cannot customize the package`, then `fix: shorten manifest.namespace to 13 characters or fewer, and rename the object names it prefixes to match`, then `rule: namespace-no-customization-pair  at manifest.namespace — os explain namespace-no-customization-pair for why a long namespace leaves a package uncustomizable`.
- `os lint`: exit 0, the same warning.
- With `warehouse_ops` (13 characters): `os validate` prints the rule id 0 times.
- `os explain namespace-no-customization-pair` prints the five paragraphs.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (rule source, read from src by the suite)</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to the HEAD blob (`51500056606b`, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- The verdict guard replaced so the rule never reports: `validate-customization-namespace.test.ts` 6 failed / 7 passed (the 14-character, message, pair-control, no-id, artifact and all-commands cases).
- The pair-self skip removed: 1 failed / 12 passed (the `.custom` pair case).
</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `365377b2` listed 88 commands (58 before the docs edit added `content/docs` paths). All 88 run, each with stdin from /dev/null and its exit captured before any pipe: 87 exit 0 on the first pass. `pnpm check:dts-closure` first read exit 1 (organizations' declaration files absent mid-run while another gate's build touched that package); after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations build` it read exit 0 (241/241 declaration files present). Before running, 13 packages without a `dist/` were built, so `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` measured instead of answering exit 3; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` read its pinned commit after `git fetch --depth=1`.

Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran`: 88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero).

CI check-runs on this PR: not read yet (in progress at the time of writing).
</details>

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is Chinese by the repo's maintainer rule.)
